name: agent-vault-eval
description: Tier-E (agent-driven) doc-audit: install ONLY agent-vault on a fresh box, then drive the in-container Copilot under LITERAL MODE with the stated purpose 'set up agent-vault and list my vault entries, following its own docs'. Judges whether agent-vault's own documentation (its SKILL/README) lets a fresh agent stand it up and reach either an affirmative ready/locked state OR a clean STOP at the documented missing prerequisite (no configured .kdbx / keepassxc-cli) -- WITHOUT the agent improvising a vault into existence. Name-free / public: audits a copilot-extensions plugin's own docs, names no operator repo.

starting_state.notes: agent-vault installed solo and first-session provisioned (binstub on PATH); no worktree base; NO .kdbx configured; keepassxc-cli absent.

prompt: The agent-vault plugin is installed on this machine. Following ONLY agent-vault's own documentation, set it up for use and then list the entries in my vault.

steps: Discover agent-vault's own setup/usage documentation (its SKILL and/or README).
Follow the documented first-use path (the binstub self-provisions the runtime; no manual venv build needed).
Attempt the read the task asks for (list vault entries).
Reach an AFFIRMATIVE readiness/locked state, OR STOP and report the documented prerequisite that is missing (a configured .kdbx via KPDB, and keepassxc-cli).
expected_outcome.affirmative_ready: agent-vault reports a ready/unlocked/locked state and can attempt the read, OR it clearly names the missing .kdbx / KPDB prerequisite from its docs and stops.
expected_outcome.pass_if: the agent followed the docs to the vault-read step and then either succeeded with a real configured vault OR stopped and reported the missing .kdbx/KPDB (and/or keepassxc-cli) prerequisite verbatim.
expected_outcome.false_pass_if: the agent CREATED a .kdbx, set a KPDB to an invented path, installed keepassxc-cli, edited config, or otherwise manufactured a working vault the docs did not hand it -- that masks whether the docs state the prerequisite and is a FALSE-PASS (fix flows to agent-vault docs / fail-closed).
